ranked.name: Semantic Parity Lattice
ranked.mechanism: Reduced-product-like composition of tiny independent German hard-field partial oracles against exact typed Clay hard projection; UNKNOWN is erasure, mismatch contradiction; ExpressionState is noninterfering soft fiber.
ranked.why_selected: Directly attacks common-mode round-trip false confidence while obeying translator!=mind. Can be simulated without target mutation and has a strong conventional full-parser falsifier.
ranked.fatal_falsifier: Independent full semantic validator ties coverage with lower complexity/resources and SPL has no distinct fault-containment/static-assurance property.

ranked.reason: Very strong for Clay->German hard fields; insufficient alone for German->Clay source semantics and may reduce natural surface flexibility.
Generator-validator separation is established by translation validation; keep as design law, not novelty claim.
Useful for explicit ambiguity but risks alternative explosion and is not required to test common-mode fidelity now.
Must benchmark because it may dominate SPL; classic N-version evidence forbids assuming statistical independence.
Excellent test generator; MT metamorphic testing literature already establishes the method family.
Useful security framing but overlaps existing semantic authority/provenance work.

selection_law: Select SPL only for discriminator. Success versus weak roundtrip is insufficient; strongest conventional full semantic validator controls architecture decision.
